args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused the nightly tests in
tests/test_money.py to fail (e.g. 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of
2.66). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the specification.

args.body:
## Summary

Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

The `round_money` function in `src/money.py` was documented to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but the implementation actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused test failures — e.g. `2.665` was rounded to `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: switched the quantize rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match the FIN-212 specification and the existing docstring.

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.
